LanguageData.TUBAD_ModName: This Used to Be About Dungeons
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_ShowIcons: Show dungeon icons on the world map
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_ShowIcons_Tip: Also toggled by the dungeon button with the other world map toggles in the bottom right.
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_TintByLevel_Tip: Colours dungeon icons from green at level 1, through yellow and red, to purple at the maximum level.
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_Generation_Desc: These settings apply when a world's dungeons are generated: new worlds, and existing saves that have never had dungeons. Worlds that already have dungeons keep them.
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_Spacing_Desc: Minimum distance between two dungeons. Each step up roughly halves to thirds how many dungeons a world gets.
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_Skew_Desc: At 1 every level is equally common; higher values make low levels more common. Now about {1} of dungeons are level {0} or lower, and {3} are level {2}.
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_Roughness_Desc: Levels rise and fall across the world like terrain. Higher values give more, smaller peaks and valleys; lower values give a few broad regions.
LanguageData.TUBAD_Settings_Ocean_Tip: When Vehicle Framework is active, dungeons are also placed on water tiles, reachable by boat.
